question.text: Under Section 12 of PMLA, transaction records must be maintained for:

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Records maintained for 5 years from date of transaction; identity records for 5 years after business relationship ends. **The Trap:** 1 year / 3 years / 10 years do not match Section 12. **Cross-Exam Context:** Same period in XXIV. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Map retention schedules in your document management system to this 5-year rule.
